description: Red night clock and screen brightness follow the room, not the clock. binary_sensor.bedroom_dark (bedroom lights off and VACA's light sensor under 3 lx) turns Android auto brightness off and sets 5% (about 12/255) through VACA; otherwise auto brightness is on (screen_auto_brightness_adj 1.0, set over ADB by the watchdog, so lamp light reads about 75-85/255 instead of 6). Moved from the HA companion app to VACA 2026-11-06; VACA pushes light changes itself, so the old ask-for-a-reading step is gone.
